lines.en: I hover; my feet never touch ground.
Ki under my feet carries me forward.

lines.zh: 四颗星的影子跟在我身后。
lines.en: The shadow of four stars trails me.

lines.zh: 我飘过屋顶，屋瓦就凉了。
lines.en: I drift over the roofs; the tiles go cold.

lines.zh: 这具身体比刚才更沉了。
lines.en: This body is heavier than before.
I dive and rise again.
A ki burst shoves me to your flank.
I leave afterimages along the way.

lines.zh: 变身后的骨架撑得满满的。
lines.en: The transformed frame is packed tight.
Three feet up, slow as a threat.
I ride my ki around behind you.
The ki wave flattens the grass.
I hover. Nothing needs doing.

lines.zh: 四星的印记在我额上发烫。
lines.en: The four-star mark burns on my brow.
Ki slowly turns around me.

lines.zh: 等你先动，我就知道方向。
lines.en: Once you move, I'll know the direction.

lines.zh: 这具身体不再需要呼吸。
lines.en: This body no longer needs breath.
Cloud shadows slide across me.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，数到一百。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats to one hundred.
The hem of my clothes still drifts.
I raise a hand and ki gathers.
Neither high nor low: just above you.
The aftershock of the change hasn't faded.
For one instant the world goes quiet.
I say nothing; the ki speaks first.

lines.zh: 形态定住了，就不容易变回去。
lines.en: Once set, this form won't easily revert.
You stand too low.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一颗没长成的星。
lines.en: I see you as an unformed star.
You carry the scent of dragon balls.
Have you made a wish?

lines.zh: 我认得你的招式，全认得。
lines.en: I know every move you have.

lines.zh: 你这副身体，撑不住几击。
lines.en: That body won't take many blows.
Don't look up at me. It tires you.
The ki in your hands is thin.
You hold still; so do I.

lines.zh: 四星的名字，你念得出来吗？
lines.en: Can you say the name of the four stars?
The light in your eyes is wavering.
Your allies didn't come with you.
I've been watching you a long while.
You don't get to pick the ground.
The more afraid you are, the wider the gap.
You're counting when I'll move.
My answer is in my fist.
That's nothing. The ki holds.
Your fist is too small.

lines.zh: 我预判了，还是让了一点。
lines.en: I foresaw it and let a little through.
One tear in the cloth.
That moved me to a new angle.
It hurts. Dragons don't fear hurt.
Ki is patching the wound.
You landed it. Worth a word.
Food? Ki suffices.

lines.zh: 你举起东西的样子很可笑。
lines.en: Holding that up looks ridiculous on you.
I don't live by my mouth.
Throw it; I'll catch it with ki.

lines.zh: 我闻不出味道，只闻出力。
lines.en: I smell no flavor, only strength.
Come closer and I'll take it as a challenge.
That won't buy a life.
What do you want? Say it.
Don't feed me. Fight me.

lines.zh: 撞上来，你撞的是一层气。
lines.en: You hit a shell of ki.
This body neither yields nor advances.

lines.zh: 你被弹开的样子很难看。
lines.en: You bounced off badly.
Three blocks away. That's courtesy.
Ki shoves you back half a meter.

lines.zh: 你的护甲碰到了我的下摆。
lines.en: Your armor brushed my hem.
Press again and I'll heat up.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你整个人重。
lines.en: My shadow outweighs your whole body.
One bump and your bones rattle.
I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 这种事对龙来说没有意义。
lines.en: This means nothing to a dragon.
Four stars don't need a second.
Just watch us.
Ki near ki will explode.
This isn't how I continue.

lines.zh: 我们在交换力量，不是别的。
lines.en: We're trading power, nothing else.

lines.zh: 两颗星并排，地上就暗了。
lines.en: Two stars side by side darken the ground.
Don't stand too close. It burns.
It became a dragon before I did.
When we part, everything nearby is scorched.
I crush this stone to powder.
Your weapon? Let me see.
Holding something is convenient.
I toss the shard back to you.

lines.zh: 这枚龙珠，不该在你手里。
lines.en: This dragon ball shouldn't be in your hands.
Picking it up taints the ki.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，但我要它不在你那。
lines.en: I don't need it. I just want it not with you.

lines.zh: 东西落地前，我已经拿到了。
lines.en: I have it before it lands.
This hand can crush iron.

lines.zh: 开始吧，你已经站在这里了。
lines.en: Let's begin. You're already standing here.
One movement and I'm locked on.
Ki has already ringed you.
In this fight I need no weapon.

lines.zh: 目标定了，别浪费我时间。
lines.en: Target set. Don't waste my time.
Backing away counts as losing.
I want to see your full strength.
The four-star light is on you.
The angle's chosen. You can't dodge.
A ki wave to start.
I dropped three feet.
Today it's only us.
I'll let you finish your sentence.
The afterimage arrives first, then me.
I circle once and close your exits.
You turn to chase. You won't reach me.
I'm holding this block of ground.

lines.zh: 你藏在树后，树干挡不住气。
lines.en: Hide behind the tree; wood stops no ki.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸没有节奏，你猜不准。
lines.en: My breathing has no rhythm. You can't guess.
Thunder is the sound of me moving.
You close in with every swing. That suits me.
The dragon ball on you is heating up.
My pause is ki gathering.
You dodge well, but not forever.
The ki edge went around your side.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙已经裂了。
lines.en: The wall behind you already cracked.
I predicted your next move.
Afterimage fist. You can't tell real from false.

lines.zh: 换三个角度，你只能挡一个。
lines.en: Three angles. You can block one.
Ki-charged charge, straight at you.
Meteor combo, blow after blow.
My fist is bigger than you are.
This blow carries dragon ki.
You're off the ground.
A ki burst follows the punch.
You blocked it; your armor burns.
This blow can take half a wall.

lines.zh: 我打的是你落地的位置。
lines.en: I aim where you'll land.
Your ki can't guard it.
Now a Death Ball.
The fist wind shears the trees.
You rolled twice on the ground.
I don't stop until you're down.

lines.zh: 这一拳，是我变身的理由。
lines.en: This punch is why I transformed.
The ki arrives; then I do.

lines.zh: 四星的光落在这片地上。
lines.en: The four-star light falls on this ground.

lines.zh: 我不是从群系里刷出来的。
lines.en: I don't spawn from a biome.
The transformation isn't finished. Wait.
Heard the thunder? That was me.
A wide shadow spreads on the ground.
When I landed, the soil turned.
This fight was arranged.
The dragon balls pointed the way.

lines.zh: 我的名字先于身体到达。
lines.en: My name arrived before my body.
The clouds part. I come out.
Smell something scorched?
The birds have all gone quiet.

lines.zh: 我站在你面前，不再隐藏。
lines.en: I stand before you, no longer hidden.
Ki flattens the grass.
This body is still growing.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，带来的是风。
lines.en: My first breath brought wind.

lines.zh: 火焰卷过，我的气被烧薄了。
lines.en: Flames sweep through and my ki burns thin.

lines.zh: 落地砸出坑，这具身体太重。
lines.en: The impact digs a crater; this body is too heavy.

lines.zh: 水压压住了气，我沉了一点。
lines.en: Water pressure pins the ki; I sink a little.
The blast peels my ki shell open.

lines.zh: 箭近不了身，不过擦到了。
lines.en: Arrows can't reach me, but one grazed.

lines.zh: 这股法术不是这个世界的东西。
lines.en: This magic isn't from this world.

lines.zh: 龙不需要进食，只是气亏。
lines.en: Dragons don't eat. My ki just runs low.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，气纹乱了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my ki pattern scrambles.
The void is swallowing my ki.
